purpose: Minimum relationship-aware vocabulary needed to make reusable family matching games possible even for Tier 3 read-and-games languages. Full-target languages derive this seed from their researched target profiles; Tier 3 stores a small explicit seed here.

game_contract.rule: A broad English gloss never authorizes collapsing a target-language distinction. These four parent/child relationships are chosen because they can support a minimal matching game without requiring cousin, uncle/aunt, sibling-age, or family-side assumptions.

trust_policy: Tier 3 seeds are machine-created candidates unless their entry says otherwise. The data exists for future games, while the normal trust UI must remain honest about verification state.
